نغتال (form VIII)
# نَغْتَالُ (naḡtālu) /naɣ.taː.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
# نُغْتَالُ (nuḡtālu) /nuɣ.taː.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
# نَغْتَالَ (naḡtāla) /naɣ.taː.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
# نُغْتَالَ (nuḡtāla) /nuɣ.taː.la/: first-person plural non-past
